summary: Completed comprehensive testing of MySQL migration from MongoDB. Verified all data is served from local MariaDB via the Mongo-compatible shim in /app/api/db.js. Admin login now uses username-based authentication (ADMIN_USERNAME env var). All 31 backend API tests and 8 frontend UI tests passed successfully. No regressions detected after migration.
